claim: E3M1 closes each street with a mass standing 3.86 to 5.80 bodies above the road (floor tile 379), outside the map's edge, faced in the district's facade lit to -8 against 24 to 34 on the masonry beside it, blocking, with a parallax sector of no height behind it so the sky comes down over it. Unlit, such an end is still a dark block at 30,000 units: the sky does the work at distance, the lit face up close. A mouth split between two districts is two masses and reads as two buildings.
evidence: E3M1 s0 (floor -90112, sky -188416) and s339 (floor -57344), backed by s338 and s340 (floor = ceiling = 8192, ceiling_stat 3); heights from bloodmap.street.end_wall
E3M1 s343 (floor -90,112, floor tile 379, sky): the third street end
use: bloodmap.street.end_wall gives the mass; make it blocking and light its face, and declare its zero-exit to the geometry audit; a sky backing of no height is exempt from the lowered-sky rule. Other ways to end a city are a waterfront (DWE3M10) or a chasm (DWE3M1).
